headline: Food Producer Beyti Plans EGP 8.7 Billion Investment in Egypt Through 2027
summary: Dairy and beverage manufacturer Beyti announced an EGP 8.7 billion capital expenditure plan for 2025-2027 in Egypt, building on EGP 7 billion already invested. The company exports to over 45 countries and employs 6,000 direct workers.
why: Manufacturing expansions reflect corporate confidence in North African consumer goods production and export competitiveness.
